certified_claim: For the locked English-plus-four-domain ontology and frozen evidence population, the V89 pre-transfer labeler routes actual teacher prompt/response records to English core, one selected domain, or fail-closed quarantine at every preregistered point-estimate gate, without invoking LayerCake or composing a training artifact.

historical_negative_evidence.reason: V88 exposed ordinary-English false Python signals and one classifier field-displacement case. It is not overwritten or promoted.

uncertainty_and_claim_boundary: The 120-row source-record-disjoint V89 holdout passes all preregistered point-estimate gates, but its per-class Wilson lower bounds do not establish the same thresholds for an arbitrary teacher-record population. This is bounded evidence for the locked ontology and source population, not exhaustive domain discovery, universal classification, proof of literally knowledge-free English, or downstream generation quality.

phase_transition.next_phase_name: normalized transfer-corpus construction and sufficient-information frontier
next_phase_requirements: Normalize labeled teacher records into an immutable training-ready representation without changing their destination labels or provenance.
Measure unique prompts, UTF-8 bytes, authoritative teacher tokens, duplication, coverage, and contamination separately for English and each selected domain.
Use preregistered nested data budgets with a fixed held-out natural generalization suite.
Define minimum only as the smallest passing tested budget paired with the largest lower failing budget.
Do not invoke LayerCake training until the normalized artifact passes adequacy, leakage, provenance, and coverage gates.
